fusions.name: Roe Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 4 spores in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage they deal comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoal Turn
fusions.desc: Hurls a spore pod that deals 12 damage, sweeps the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It then drifts on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each.

fusions.name: Gill Bloom
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Slime Coat
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, a ward absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
